card.name: Size number after "two" or "x"
card.fires_on: The first digit or space of a size number that follows a count such as "two" or "2 x", right before a unit like mg, mL, ounce or minute.

modes.label: Digit after count
modes.description: A digit of the per-unit amount right after a multiplier such as "2 x" or "two".

modes.label: Space after "two"
modes.description: The space between "two" and a size figure like 6-ounce or 450 mg.
